repos.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: HelloGitHub 是一个专注于分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级开源项目的月刊栏目。它通过精选开源项目、书籍和实战案例，帮助开发者快速感受开源魅力，降低参与开源的门槛，促进开源文化的传播与交流。
repos.summary_en: HelloGitHub is a popular community-driven project dedicated to sharing interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub. Published as a monthly newsletter, it curates high-quality open source tools, practical tutorials, and books, helping developers of all levels quickly discover the joy of open source and easily kickstart their open source journey.

repos.description: 坚持分享 GitHub 上高质量、有趣实用的开源技术教程、开发者工具、编程网站、技术资讯。A list cool, interesting projects of GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: GitHubDaily 是一个持续更新的开源项目推荐仓库，累计分享超万个高质量 GitHub 项目，覆盖 AI 工具、学习教程、开发工具等类别，帮助开发者快速发现优质资源、掌握技术趋势、提升编程技能。
repos.summary_en: GitHubDaily is a curated list of cool, interesting GitHub projects, sharing over 10,000 high-quality resources across AI tools, tutorials, and dev utilities to help developers discover top projects, track tech trends, and improve coding skills.

repos.description: 🌈谷粒-Chrome插件英雄榜, 为优秀的Chrome插件写一本中文说明书, 让Chrome插件英雄们造福人类~  ChromePluginHeroes, Write a Chinese manual for the excellent Chrome plugin, let the Chrome plugin heroes benefit the human~ 公众号「0加1」同步更新
repos.summary_zh: 本项目开源，专注为优秀Chrome插件编写中文说明书，利用docsify构建文档站点并托管于GitHub Pages。内容涵盖广告屏蔽、视频下载、翻译等实用插件，旨在降低使用门槛，让插件真正造福用户，提升浏览体验。
repos.summary_en: This open-source project provides Chinese manuals for outstanding Chrome extensions. It leverages docsify to build a documentation site hosted on GitHub Pages, covering extensions for ad blocking, video downloading, translation, and more, aiming to empower users and enhance browsing efficiency.

repos.description: ⛅️ 精选的 Cloudflare 工具、开源项目、指南、博客和其他资源列表。/ ⛅️ A curated list of Cloudflare tools, open source projects, guides, blogs and other resources.
repos.summary_zh: 仓库精选Cloudflare生态的开源工具与资源，帮助独立开发者提高效率、减少成本。覆盖图床、邮箱、博客、脚手架等多个类别，工具简单便捷，便于快速部署。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates a list of Cloudflare-based open-source tools, guides, and resources, designed to help indie developers boost efficiency and reduce costs. It covers various domains such as image hosting, email, blogs, scaffolds, URL shorteners, and website analytics, ensuring simplicity and ease of use for quick deployment.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Zhuiju Free 是一个开源、免费无广告的追剧资源指南，通过人工精选和每日自动化检测确保资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox配置、IPTV直播源等多类资源，社区共同维护，适合追剧爱好者快速获取可靠资源。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Zhuiju Free is an open-source, ad-free guide for drama chasing resources, featuring manually curated selections and daily automated availability checks. It aggregates online videos, apps, cloud storage searches, magnets, subtitles, TVBox configs, IPTV sources, and more, community-maintained for reliable resource discovery.
